meta.description: Calculate SaaS revenue, retention, and growth metrics. Use when diagnosing momentum, churn, expansion, or product-market-fit signals.

copy.tagline: 计算SaaS收入、留存与增长指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析SaaS业务的收入、流失和增长趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate SaaS revenue, retention, and growth metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze SaaS revenue, churn, and growth trends.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你计算和解读 SaaS 收入、留存和增长指标，如 MRR、ARR、流失率、净收入留存率等，并分析趋势、识别问题。
howto.when: 当你询问 SaaS 业务健康度、产品市场匹配度，或要求计算 MRR、流失率、NRR 等指标时触发。

say.text: 帮我计算并解读我们的 MRR、流失率和 NRR，用于董事会汇报。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤计算并给出解读。

say.text: 解释总留存和净留存率的区别，以及如何提升净留存率。
say.note: Claude 会解释概念并提供改进建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can calculate and interpret SaaS revenue, retention, and growth metrics such as MRR, ARR, churn rate, and NRR, and analyze trends to identify issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about SaaS business health, product-market fit, or request calculation of metrics like MRR, churn, or NRR.

say_en.text: Calculate and interpret our MRR, churn rate, and NRR for a board deck.
say_en.note: Claude will compute and provide insights.

say_en.text: Explain the difference between gross and net revenue retention and how to improve it.
say_en.note: Claude will explain concepts and suggest improvements.
